name: Maralen of the Mornsong
description: The elf whose selfish nature Oona used as a mask for her avatar.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
timeline.quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.
